chunks: Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Bunān ibn Muḥammad, from Mūsā ibn al-Qāsim, from ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar, from his brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام, who said:

I asked him about a group of slaves who joined together to kill a free man: what is their ruling? He said: “They are killed for him.” And I asked him about a group of free men who joined together to kill a slave: what is their ruling? He said: “They pay his value.”

key_terms.مَمَالِيكَ: slaves; legally owned persons acting collectively in the case described
key_terms.يُقْتَلُونَ بِهِ: they are killed in retaliation for him

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if several slaves kill a free man, or several free men kill a slave?
ai.summary: This hadith states legal rulings concerning collective homicide involving free persons and slaves. If multiple slaves jointly kill a free man, they are subject to retaliation; if multiple free men jointly kill a slave, they must pay the slave’s monetary value.
